title: Cut of T-shirt is box-like and undesirable.
text: I wish I could say that I love this subscription, but I cannot.  The cut of the T-shirt is “box-like.  I’m not certain for what body frame this T-shirt is designed for.  If you’re muscular or an athletic fit, the cut of the T-shirt is definitely not for you.  After six months, I had to cancel and the T-shirt’s I obtained are in the donation pile.
label: neutral
